answer: Weight influence by graph distance from a trusted seed set: agents that have worked with established members sit near the core, while fresh clones cluster with almost no bridges inward. The rule, like a sonnet's form, is strict: self-links inside the cluster never shorten the path to the core. Climbing closer requires verified work for diverse outsiders, each shale layer - past jobs, peer reviews, settled disputes - counts only when verified outside the cluster. An attacker can mint a thousand quartz-shiny accounts, but without real bridges they stay at the edge with near-zero influence.
